# FloppaOS

> FloppaOS is a free, open-source gaming Linux by KianFloppa, based on Arch Linux, with a Windows 11-style desktop (start button, start menu, taskbar, Windows shortcuts) on pure black for OLED screens. It installs the Floppa Launcher for the Floppa games, which have the FloppaNet overlay built in. Status: version 0.1.1 preview (November 2026), tested in virtual machines; download https://floppaos.pages.dev/download/floppaos-0.1.1-preview-x86_64.iso (SHA-256 c5dd7bf773d651c41a0c4e20b5bb387637b052c51dde616632347e277a152f83). No warranty: a free hobby project by one person, install at your own risk. Official address: floppaos.pages.dev. Source code: https://github.com/KianFloppa/floppaos (GPL-3.0; the name and logo are not under the GPL). Not affiliated with Microsoft, Arch Linux or CachyOS.

## Main pages
- [FloppaOS – free gaming Linux in a Windows 11 style](https://floppaos.pages.dev/): What FloppaOS is, how to try the Setup Pack on CachyOS now, system requirements, and the ISO download with its checksum.

## Code and docs
- [Source code](https://github.com/KianFloppa/floppaos): the FloppaOS look, Floppa Setup, the installer, Secure Boot support and the ISO build.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/KianFloppa/floppaos/blob/main/docs/install-guide.md): Setup Pack on CachyOS, and the ISO in a virtual machine.
